iterations.scope: Complete useful-offer rewrite covering platform, catalogue, integrations, technical SEO, process, measurement, scoped pricing and FAQ; unsupported statistics, fixed prices and guarantees removed.

neuronWriter.wordCountMethod: Unicode word tokens in the visible text of main#main-content, including shared selected-work content; this is a local verification count, not a NeuronWriter metric.
neuronWriter.method: evaluate-content through neuron_client.py evaluate-html; outerHTML of main#main-content extracted from final dist/uslugi/sklepy-internetowe/krakow/index.html; final title and description supplied explicitly.
neuronWriter.scopeComparison: The 84 baseline used the public URL and main-content. The final 95 measurement used the same semantic container from the local production prerender, including page and shared selected-work content but excluding navigation and footer. The content scope is comparable, while the measurement environment differs.
